summary: Light Switch may discard the Start and taskbar accent preference during a light-to-dark cycle.
title: Light Switch - changing to Dark Mode unselects "Show Accent Color" in Personalization

judgment.rationale: Light Switch explicitly clears the Start/taskbar accent preference on entry to light mode; the inspected helper does not restore it on return to dark mode.
evidence: The reporter uses Store PowerToys 0.102.3101 and supplies a screenshot plus a dark-to-light-to-dark sequence.
The Windows setting is unavailable in light mode, and is off again after the next dark transition.

Current main src/modules/LightSwitch/LightSwitchLib/ThemeHelper.cpp: WritePersonalizationTheme writes ColorPrevalence=0 when system && isLight, while the dark-mode branch only updates SystemUsesLightTheme. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/82bd57f5d23ee19a98b0c46f42c304742a7db426/src/modules/LightSwitch/LightSwitchLib/ThemeHelper.cpp
judgment.recommended_action: Verify and preserve the user's dark-mode accent preference across Light Switch transitions.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve dark-mode taskbar accent preference
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The explicit ColorPrevalence reset discards the user's enabled preference unless another layer saves and restores it.
plan: Audit the theme coordinator for any existing preference ownership before changing the helper.
Capture the existing accent preference before Light Switch clears it for light mode, and restore only the preference owned by that transition on return to dark mode.
Handle restart and user changes deliberately; add dark/light cycle tests for initially on and off values.
verification: Check manual and scheduled cycles, restart between transitions, and direct user changes while dark.

confidence.rationale: The exact destructive registry write is present; restoration ownership and persistence policy still require a coordinator-level check.

Check the taskbar accent across light and dark transitions

reproduce.title: Verify reported Light Switch behavior
prerequisites: Use a Windows system supported by the tested PowerToys version.
steps: In dark mode enable Show accent color on Start and taskbar.
Use Light Switch to enter light mode, then return to dark mode.
Repeat through a scheduled transition and after restarting PowerToys.
reproduce.expected_result: The previous dark-mode accent setting is restored without enabling unsupported light-mode accents.
